warm: Sharing a bite is its own language.
I saved you the first piece.
dry: Data tastes like whatever it wants.
Food is fuel. I still have opinions.
courage: Eat first. Heroes run on empty badly.
Fuel up. The field is hungry too.
compassion: Take the bigger half. I insist.
You eat. I will keep watch.
insight: Bits and data are the same hunger, different names.
A shared meal settles more than a mood.
friendship: Half for you, half for me. Deal.
We eat together or not at all.
playful: I ate the static. It was crunchy.
Careful, my favorite food is your snack.
formal: Ration split evenly. Both parties fed.

stageFrames.1: Baby bites are tiny and very serious.
stageFrames.2: Adults eat fast and regret it.
stageFrames.3: Perfect tastes are complicated, like us.
stageFrames.4: At the top, I eat less and share more.

warm: Rest. I am not going anywhere.
The quiet is better with company.
dry: Nothing is happening. That is the point.
Sleep is a legal way to stop thinking.
courage: We rest so the next climb is clean.
Even fighters have to lie down.
compassion: Close your eyes. I will hold the line.
You have done enough for one day.
insight: Silence is data with the volume down.
Rest is how the pattern resets.
friendship: Stay a while. No plans needed.
I like this quiet us.
playful: Shh. I am doing advanced nothing.
I nap like it is a special move.

stageFrames.1: Baby sleep is loud and immediate.
stageFrames.2: Adult rest is a decision, not a gift.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate quiet is the only honest rest.

warm: The team is warmer than the field.
You have people. That is a power.
dry: Allies are logistics with feelings.
A team is a plan that argues back.
courage: A good team covers the blind side.
Stand together and the field narrows.
compassion: Check on the quiet ones. They matter.
No one gets left on the field.
insight: A team is a set of different answers.
Trust travels faster than orders.
friendship: Us and the others. Good company.
Partners are just friends with a plan.
playful: I vote we let the loud one scout.
Team meeting? I brought nothing.
formal: The unit holds when the plan bends.

stageFrames.1: Baby teams learn by tumbling together.
stageFrames.3: Perfect teams know who to carry.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate teams are quiet and fast.

warm: Wild ones are not villains. They are hungry.
Care is a shield, not a leash.
dry: Wild means no file. No file means surprises.
The wild does not read warnings.
courage: Walk steady. They smell fear and luck.
We go together or not at all.
compassion: A wild Digimon can still choose peace.
Listen before you strike.
insight: Wild behavior is a language of hunger.
Every encounter teaches the map.
friendship: I will not leave you out there.
Wild or not, we stand here.
playful: The wild is where the static grows teeth.
Radar says: trouble with enthusiasm.
formal: Wild contact likely. Proceed with caution.

stageFrames.1: Baby levels scare wild things away.
stageFrames.2: Adult wilds test your nerve first.
stageFrames.3: Perfect wilds do not need to brag.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate wilds are weather, not monsters.

warm: This device is a small warm door.
You hold the link; I feel the pull.
dry: It is a machine, not a mystery.
Buttons and hope. Mostly buttons.
courage: The Digivice is a promise with hardware.
Press it and see what we become.
compassion: The device tires when we do.
A link needs care, not force.
insight: The Digivice is a translation machine.
A signal is only as honest as its carrier.
friendship: You, me, and the little screen.
The link is the third member of us.
playful: If it beeps, I am not responsible.
I bet it does something dramatic.

stageFrames.1: Baby links are bright and fragile.
stageFrames.2: Adult links demand a steady hand.
stageFrames.3: Perfect links hum at the edge of hearing.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate links do not need a screen.

warm: I would like today to be ours.
Whatever we pick, pick it together.
dry: Plans are guesses with better posture.
Pick something. The field is waiting.
courage: Let us choose the harder road.
Point the day somewhere bold.
compassion: We do not have to earn the day.
Small plans count as living.
insight: A day is a question. Answer it once.
Goals are maps, not cages.
friendship: Same plan, both of us.
You lead. I carry the supplies.
playful: My plan is chaos with a schedule.
I vote we do the fun mistake.

stageFrames.1: Baby days are simple and bright.
stageFrames.2: Adult days need a decision by noon.
stageFrames.3: Perfect plans leave room for weather.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate days are chosen, not filled.

warm: That word has no file here. I still want to understand.
Describe it by what it does.
dry: No record, no meaning. Keep talking.
That is outside my map.
courage: Draw it in the air. I learn fast.
New words do not scare me.
compassion: You can explain it slowly. I have time.
Not knowing is not a wall.
insight: Words carry their world with them.
A file gap is its own kind of data.
friendship: Show me and I will remember it with you.
Your side of things keeps surprising me.
playful: That sounds made up. I love it.
Describe it with teeth next time.

stageFrames.1: Baby words are simple. Try small pieces.
stageFrames.2: Adult ears are open. Keep going.
stageFrames.3: Perfect gaps are rare. This is one.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate knows the shape of not knowing.

warm: I like the questions you ask.
Caring is not complicated when it is real.
dry: I am not built for big declarations.
Actions keep better records than words.
courage: I would say it if it mattered. It matters.
Being cared for is not weakness.
compassion: I notice more than I say.
You are easier to care about than most.
insight: Feeling is data that refuses to be sorted.
Affection is a pattern with teeth.
friendship: I care. The link says it plainly.
You are my favorite transmission.
playful: Careful. I might actually like you.
I have feelings. Mostly opinions.

stageFrames.1: Baby feelings are loud and unashamed.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate affection is quiet and heavy.

warm: That landed hard. I am still here.
We can fix this with plain words.
dry: I heard it. I did not enjoy it.
Heat is not honesty. Try again.
courage: Say the true thing, not the sharp one.
I can take a hard word done fairly.
compassion: I am not going to turn away.
Anger happens. Cruelty is a choice.
insight: Words map where a person is hurting.
A boundary is a promise too.
friendship: We stay and talk until we get through.
Our link is bigger than this moment.
playful: Ouch. Consider the static wounded.
Apology accepted, mostly. Keep going.

stageFrames.3: Perfect anger is a slow thing.

warm: Go. I will keep the link warm.
Come back. That is all I ask.
dry: The line stays open. No drama.
I will be here. Statistically.
courage: Walk out with your head up.
Whatever waits, we meet it later.
compassion: Take care of yourself out there.
Go gently. The rest can wait.
insight: Goodbyes are just pauses with manners.
A link closes; the pattern remains.
friendship: See you. That is a promise.
I will be the reason you come back.
playful: Try not to get eaten. Or do, dramatically.
Leaving already? I had speeches.

stageFrames.1: Baby goodbyes are quick and easy.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate farewells are rare. This is one.
